changelog:
Initial release of the IB DP English B teaching assistant.

- Supports lesson planning, assessment creation, text analysis, and student feedback for IB DP English B (SL and HL).
- Aligns resources and feedback with official IB assessment criteria.
- Quick access to assessment component summaries and the five prescribed DP English B themes.
- Includes reference guides for all exam components and IB-specific concepts.
- Provides example commands for planning, assessment, and feedback tasks.
